instruction: In the court of the shrines, at the great door whose doorstone of alabaster lies broken in front of the doorway and not in its place, with a tethering ring at its right: under the doorstone, 3 cubits: [deposit].
context: Redacted site description: a royal citadel of the late eighth century BCE with a group of temples around a nearly square main court and a smaller second court. Several temple doorways open from the main court, each with a stone threshold; the entrances of the larger temples are flanked by buttresses with glazed-brick panels and statues. The walls of the court are named by their compass sides.

features.type: monumental temple doorway with stone threshold

position.relative_to: centre of the main temple court (north-west side, right of the court axis)

features.dimensions: threshold originally one slab filling the passage
features.notes: Alabaster threshold found broken into several pieces just in front of the doorway, not in place. Inscribed. Flanked by buttresses with glazed-brick panels; a stone ring set in the floor in the corner to the right of the doorway, a socket for a matching ring on the left.

features.type: monumental temple doorway with stone threshold

position.relative_to: second, smaller court (reached through another room)

features.notes: Threshold in place, inscribed. Ring hole near the right buttress; the ring itself lay nearby. Burnt layer over the court pavement.

features.type: monumental temple doorway with stone threshold

position.relative_to: centre of the main temple court (south-west side, right of the court axis)

features.opening: doorway destroyed on the court side
features.notes: Limestone threshold lying out of place in front of the doorway; inscription badly weathered. Flanking panels and statues fallen on the pavement; any floor rings destroyed with the pavement edge.

features.type: portal with stone threshold to a small chamber

position.relative_to: centre of the main temple court (north-east side, centre)

features.notes: Threshold of several blocks, uninscribed; smaller buttresses without glazed panels.

position.relative_to: centre of the main temple court (north-west side, near the west corner)

features.notes: Threshold in place, inscribed with a prayer. No buttresses or panels. Foundation-deposit boxes under the pavement on both sides held only sand.

position.relative_to: centre of the main temple court (south-west side, near the south corner)

features.notes: Threshold in place with an eight-line inscription; foundation boxes outside had been opened before.

withheld_question: Where on the chosen doorstone is the inscription?
